about: Reviewed resolutions for keys the line map cannot carry. Keyed by the key as written at the basis (2243be380b). A function key whose function lost a definition while keeping at least one ('fewer_definitions'): 'as': 'deleted' (this key's own definition is the one removed: its rules are pruned) or n (it is the target's n-th definition of that name, 1-based); such an entry applies only where the map finds fewer definitions for its key. A site key inside a function the revision deleted from its file ('replaced', because its hunk carries other new lines): 'as': 'deleted' with 'fn', the enclosing basis function; it applies only when that function encloses the basis line and is no longer defined in the file at the revision. 'why' names the commit and the code facts.
